Hi Laura — thanks for the quick note and the attachments. Sorry for the disruption. A few likely causes we see: duplicate vendor profile (same legal name / DUNS) in a different Ariba tenant, or an identity cookie tying you to an older account.

Quick asks so we can triage fast:
- Confirm the exact email you used to accept the invite (you said two attempts — which addresses?).
- Can you try the tenant-scoped URL instead: https://ariba.redwood-inference.com/supplier-onboard?tenant=redwood-us (paste into an incognito window and try).
- If you still hit the same error, Rishi will coordinate an account merge or mapping on the vendor ops side.

I’ve looped Rishi (vendor ops) and Monica (procurement lead). Rishi — can you check SUP-4567 (linked) for duplicate ClearLine entries and advise the safe path (merge vs new mapping)? If we need a signed form, I’ll send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Thanks Priya — I looked into SUP-4567 and I see two vendor profiles for ClearLine: ClearLine_US (created 2019) and ClearLine_Intl (created 2026) — both tied to the same DUNS. Ariba is rejecting the onboarding because the incoming assertion references ClearLine_US.

Plan:
1) I can merge the two profiles at the tenant level and preserve the recent account identifier. That requires vendor confirmation (legal name + DUNS) and acceptance of our updated supplier terms (DocuSign).
2) If the vendor prefers not to merge, we can create a tenant alias for the new invite so their acceptance maps to the correct profile; this avoids changing existing records but takes slightly longer.

Laura — quick question: which email did you try? The merge requires that the accepting email be added to the consolidated profile (I can add it for you). If you want the fastest outcome for the PO, option 1 with a merge + accept is typically the quickest (I can do the merge now if you sign the small procurement onboarding addendum).

I’m attaching the short DUNS export you already provided to the Jira ticket. I’ll prepare the DocuSign and post the link here.
